entries.en: You're doubtless aware, <if(gnum4,Mistress,Master)> <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, that we Qitari possess eminently keen noses. Even in pitch-black darkness, we can discern one of our own from another and locate them.
entries.macro: You're doubtless aware, <if(gnum4,Mistress,Master)> <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, that we Qitari possess eminently keen noses. Even in pitch-black darkness, we can discern one of our own from another and locate them.
entries.fr: Qitari avoir odorat très développé<nbsp>! Finaud finaud<nbsp>! Reconnaître odeur de camarades explorateurs entre mille dans cavernes ténébreuuuses<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
わたくしどもキタリ族の鼻の良さを、ご存知でしょか～？
真っ暗闇の中であっても、匂いだけで仲間を嗅ぎ分け、
その位置を知れるほどなので、ございまする～！

entries.en: However, the caverns we explore can be filled with strange gases that confuse our sense of smell. To cut through this haze, we've taken to using a special perfume, which I would concoct with your assistance.
entries.fr: Mais parfois, gaz nauséabonds des cavernes entraver odorat finaud<nbsp>! Qhoterl Pasol aussi alchimiste à heures perdues<nbsp>! Produire parfum suuurpuissant pour qu'explorateurs pouvoir continuer de se reconnaître entre eux<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
しかし、地下洞窟での探索では、
ガスなどで匂いが紛れる可能性がありましょ～。
それゆえ目印代わりの香水を、調合したいのでございまする～！
